title: ITR-3 Schedules CYLA, BFLA, CFL and UD (Set-off and carry forward) - data
description: The opening position only: losses and unabsorbed depreciation carried into this year from earlier years. Schedules CYLA, BFLA, CFL and UD are computed from this and from this year's income.

brought_forward.description: Losses carried into this year from earlier returns. The assessment year of origin decides when they expire.

return_filed_on.description: ISO date the return for the year of the loss was filed, as the document prints it. Schedule CFL has a column for it, and a loss other than a house-property loss survives only if that return was filed in time.
